title: Local Skills examples for OCI GenAI workshop
change_summary: Added local, inline, and curated Skill usage examples plus two richer sample Skill folders.
impact: Teams can practice Skill packaging and local execution patterns while hosted Skill upload access is pending.
ask: Review the examples, run the preview mode, and share feedback before the next workshop.
try_it: Run `uv run openai_sdk/skills/local_skill_usage.py` with RUN_LIVE_API left as False to inspect the request shape.
next_steps: Review the local Skill folder structure.
Run each bundled helper script with its example JSON input.
Update Slack and Outlook copy for your own team.
feedback_path: Reply in the workshop Slack channel or send feedback by Outlook.
risks: Hosted Skill upload is not enabled in this environment yet.
Local shell execution requires application-owned guardrails.
